title: ExplorerUsageLink
responsibility: Opens a consumer entity and previews its own revision-bound screenshot on hover or keyboard focus.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.entity
inputs.description: The consumer entity this link opens: `name` is the link text, `id` and `category` address its target, and `caller.sourceOnly` turns the link into a source button. Its screenshot is looked up from `unit`, and only for pages, layouts and components while the preview is open.

examples.name: ExplorerUsageLink
examples.purpose: Opens a consumer entity and previews its own revision-bound screenshot on hover or keyboard focus.

unit.title: ExplorerUsageLink
unit.responsibility: Opens a consumer entity and previews its own revision-bound screenshot on hover or keyboard focus.

verdict.label: Coverage incomplete
reasons: No scenario covers this unit; tests alone do not show how it behaves.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.nav
inputs.description: How the link reaches other places: `route` is the location every link target is derived from, so each target keeps its branch and commit. `href` and `go` give each entity link its address and click action, and the optional `source` enables the source button, which is disabled when it is absent.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.lens
inputs.description: The host's evidence resolver: this component calls only `evidence`, with the entity's own `unit`, and only while the preview of a visual entity (pages, layouts or components) is open. Non-visual entities and closed previews never call it.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.mediaBase
inputs.description: The URL prefix of the media folder: the preview image's `src` is this prefix followed directly by the capture's file name, which is its media path with the leading `media/` removed, and no separator is added. It is read only while a visual entity's preview shows its image.

outputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink
outputs.description: The link markup: an `hx-span` with class `ex-usage-link` holding either an `hx-button` source button, for an entity whose `caller.sourceOnly` is true, or an `EntityLink` labelled with `entity.name`. While hover or keyboard focus opens it (a touch pointer never does), a `role="tooltip"` `hx-span` holds the preview: the screenshot with its origin line for visual categories, or else the code label (`caller.symbol`, falling back to `unit.title`) and `role`, with a text fallback when no screenshot is recorded or it fails to load.

errors.name: nav.href callback error
errors.description: The error that `nav.href` throws while an entity link renders; it propagates out of this component for every entity not shown as a source button.

errors.name: nav.go callback error
errors.description: The error that `nav.go` throws when a click the link handles calls it; a modified click or any other mouse button stays with the browser and never calls it.

errors.name: nav.source callback error
errors.description: The error that `nav.source` throws when the source button is activated; the button's click handler does not catch it.

errors.name: lens.evidence callback error
errors.description: The error that `lens.evidence` throws when a visual entity's preview opens on hover or focus; the component does not catch it.
